component.name: Lithnode
component.summary: Draw a team of coding agents and run it

description.p: Lithnode runs teams of coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex and Cursor) as a graph you draw. Give each team a job, its command-line tools and connectors, split big jobs across agents, and have others check the work.
Every agent runs on your own sign-in and plan. Lithnode is free and never charges you.
